conclusion: No clean transcription (TEI, Wikisource, Gutenberg) of Edmonds' Lyra Graeca exists on an open host; the best open digital form is Internet Archive page OCR. Among the IA scans, the Princeton-contributed 2022 Tesseract derivations (lyragraecabeingr01unse, lyragraecabeingr02unse) and the 1928 revised vol. I (lyragraeca0001jmed_c0b1) were OCR'd with Greek models and give real Greek text; the Toronto scans already in data/raw/lyra (lyragraecabeingr01edmouoft, lyragraecavol20002jmed, lyragraecabeingr03edmouoft) have Latin-only OCR (no Greek characters at all). No open vol. III scan with Greek OCR was found.
